name: Shop Manager for Woocommerce
author: WPKIN

sections.description:
🛍️ Shop Manager for Woocommerce provides a modern, efficient interface for managing WooCommerce orders. Built with React and Ant Design, it offers a seamless experience for store administrators and managers.

⭐ Key Features

  • 🎯 Modern React-based interface
  • ⚡ Quick order creation and editing
  • 📱 Responsive design for all devices
  • 📊 User-friendly dashboard
  • 🏷️ Order status management

🎯 Perfect For

  • 🏪 E-commerce store managers
  • 🛒 Online retailers
  • 👨‍💼 WooCommerce store administrators
  • 🔑 Shop managers
  • 💼 E-commerce business owners

🔧 Requirements

  • ✅ WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • ✅ WooCommerce 6.0 or higher
  • ✅ PHP 7.4 or higher

📚 Additional Information

🌟 Features in Detail

  • 🎨 Modern Interface:

    • Built with React
    • Smooth user experience
    • Intuitive navigation

  • 📦 Order Management:

    • ✨ Create new orders
    • 📝 Edit existing orders
    • 🗑️ Delete orders
    • 🔍 View order details
    • 🔄 Update order status

📥 Installation

  1. 📁 Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/shop-manager directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. ✨ Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. ⚙️ Use the Settings->Shop Manager screen to configure the plugin
  4. 🎉 Access the dashboard via WooCommerce->Shop Manager

🖼️ Screenshots

  1. 📊 Main Dashboard
  2. 📦 Order Management Interface
  3. ✨ Order Creation Form
  4. 🔍 Order Details View
  5. 📱 Mobile View
sections.faq:
🔄 Is WooCommerce required for this plugin?

Yes, Shop Manager is specifically designed for WooCommerce and requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

📦 Can I manage all aspects of orders through this plugin?

Yes, Shop Manager provides comprehensive order management capabilities including creation, editing, status updates, and deletion.

📱 Is it mobile-friendly?

Yes, the interface is fully responsive and works well on all devices including mobile phones and tablets.

🏷️ Does it support all WooCommerce order statuses?

Yes, it supports all default WooCommerce order statuses and any custom order statuses you’ve added.
